class.name: RosTfBroadcaster
class.brief_description: A broadcaster for coordinate transforms in the ROS 2 TF2 system.
class.description: [RosTfBroadcaster] allows Godot to send coordinate transforms (positions and rotations) to the ROS 2 transformation tree (TF2). It is created through [method RosNode.create_tf_broadcaster]. By sending transforms, you can communicate the spatial relationship between different parts of a robot or environment to other ROS 2 nodes.

method.name: send_transform
method.description: Sends a coordinate transformation from [param parent_frame_id] to [param frame_id]. If [param is_static] is [code]true[/code], the transform is sent as a static transform which is typically only sent once.
